definitions.gloss: rest, recuperation, taking a break to recover
definitions.explanation: The act of resting to restore one's physical or mental health. Implies a more deliberate, extended period of rest than a simple break.

examples.japanese: {休養|きゅうよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{休養|きゅうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The doctor told me I need rest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{怪我|けが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{休養|きゅうよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The athlete entered a one-month rest period due to injury.

notes:
GRAMMAR: Functions as a noun and as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({休養|きゅうよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休養|きゅうよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take a rest)
- {休養|きゅうよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to begin a rest period)
- ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な{休養|きゅうよう} (sufficient rest)
- {休養|きゅうよう}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (rest period)

SIMILAR WORDS: ⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧ is a short break during an activity, while {休養|きゅうよう} is a longer, more deliberate period of rest for recovery. ⟦{療養|りょうよう}→療養：08207_ryouyou⟧ specifically means medical recuperation.
